SYNTH_STRATEGY - Changing this option over to an area or raw delay strategy rewrites ABC's optimization profile, completely stripping out the crashing sequential timing sub-commands (like scorr)!
SYNTH_YOSYS_OPTIONS - Passes global parameters to completely freeze sequential mapping tracking, forcing Yosys to evaluate all internal loops flatly as discrete standard logic gates.
PL_RESIZE_BUFFER_PERCENTAGE - Allocates 0% extra space for timing resizing. This instructs the placement resizer script to stop scaling logic gates for synchronous setup windows.
PL_RESIZER_DESIGN_OPTIMIZATIONS - Explicitly bars OpenROAD from altering your custom combinational cell structures or feedback nets to clear virtual setup margins.
PL_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Turns off timing-driven placement optimization loops globally inside the RePlAce engine profile.
GLB_RESIZER_TIMING_OPTIMIZATIONS - Stops the global routing pass optimizer from attempting to resize your cell gates across your module boundaries.

PL_RESIZER_HOLD_MAX_BUFFER_PERCENT - Drops your hold fixing area allowance directly down to 0. This structurally forbids the OpenROAD resizer script from inserting delay buffers into your clockless macro wires, preserving your 100% pure asynchronous delays!
